kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انذأفت (form VII)
# اِنْذَأَفْتُ (inḏaʔaftu) /in.ða.ʔaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
# اِنْذَأَفْتَ (inḏaʔafta) /in.ða.ʔaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
# اِنْذَأَفْتِ (inḏaʔafti) /in.ða.ʔaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْذَأَفَ (inḏaʔafa)
# اِنْذَأَفَتْ (inḏaʔafat) /in.ða.ʔa.fat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
